rules.statement: A deed dealing with a divided lot of a larger land falls under proviso (a) of section 15(1) when there are earlier registrations affecting the larger land, and must be registered in a separate folio connecting it with the entry relating to the whole area by cross-references.
rules.supporting_quote: "Now section 14 (7) shows how the registrar is to obtain the information with regard to earlier registrations. It provides that 'any instrument (except a will) presented for registration (shall contain) a reference to the volume and folio in which some earlier instrument relating to the same land is registered if such reference is known to the notary'."
